reading.title: Prepositions of Place 2: Organising an Office Move
reading.text: During a small office move, clear location language prevents mistakes. The instructions use against, around, among, within, and beyond. For routes and movement, the team also uses into, out of, onto, off, and through. To describe exact parts of a surface or room, the note includes across, along, over, past, and toward. Each instruction is checked before a box or piece of furniture is moved.
